description: This file defines benchmark classes for elementwise operations, including a template class 'ElementBench' and specific implementations like 'SimpleElementBench' and 'DynamicSimpleElementBench'. It also registers various elementwise operations (e.g., add, mul, erf) with different configurations, and handles benchmarking setup for tensor operations using PyTorch, NumPy, and SciPy.

classes.name: ElementBench
classes.description: A template class for elementwise operations, allowing customization of binary and unary functions, and managing input tensors and evaluation logic.

classes.name: SimpleElementBench
classes.description: A simple benchmark class for elementwise operations on a single tensor, with basic forward and reference methods.

classes.name: DynamicSimpleElementBench
classes.description: A dynamic shape extension of SimpleElementBench, supporting variable input shapes.

methods.name: register_element_ops
methods.description: Registers various elementwise operation classes with different configurations (split/shared input, operation type) into the benchmark registry.
